rows: The variables block's version 2: "version": 2, "names", "defaults" (each name's default, any JSON value: the code's own constant, never an org's value) and "deploy"; pubrules.variables.upgrade reads version 1 as 2 through its transformer (version: 2, defaults: {}), defaults() reads a block's defaults and canonical() compares them; sync --check takes either version
